keep.text: Agar namak zeher hai, itna hi khatarnak hai, toh hospital mein doctor sabse pehle aap logon ko zeher kyun chadha deta hai?
Kisi ko stroke aaya, kisi ko heart attack aaya, koi collapse ho gaya, koi behosh ho gaya, toh bina kuch pooche samjhe, bina kuch jaanche
sabse pehle saline chadha di jaati hai.
Saline yaani ki NaCl,
yaani ki sodium chloride.
Ab ek sodium chloride ke bag mein 9000 mg sodium hota hai.
Kabhi kabhi push kar dete hain,
double bag chadh jaata hai, yaani ki 18,000 milligram sodium directly nason mein chadh jaata hai.
Ab samjho sodium karta kya hai body mein. Sodium ek electrolyte hai, aur ye aapke cell ke andar aur bahar paani ka balance maintain karta hai. Aur iske bina
kidneys filter nahi kar sakti, iske bina heart pump nahi kar sakta, nerves signal dena band kar dengi aap logon ko.
Ab aapki kidneys ke andar ek secret function hai.
Jab aapki body mein sodium kam hota hai na, toh kidneys pagal ho jaati hain. Unhe sodium reabsorb karna padta hai.
Par kidneys ye kaam tabhi kar sakti hain jab insulin badhe.
Toh brain pancreas ko signal bhejta hai ki insulin badhao. Insulin badha toh kya hua?
Blood mein jo sugar thi wo cells mein kheechi gayi,
aur sugar drop ho gayi.
Aur jab sugar drop hui
toh brain bola, danger hai bhai! Bhookh lagi, aur sabse specifically meetha chahiye, instant energy chahiye mujhe meethe se.
Aapko laga ki meetha chahiye tha,
par body ko namak chahiye tha. Aur kya kiya duniya ne?
Namak ko villain bana diya
taaki sugar industries chamak jaayein,
diseases flourish karein.

Ek aur baat. Excess salt body urine se nikaal deti hai, but excess sugar fat store kar deti hai, aur ye fat permanently store ho jaata hai. Ab sawaal ye hai ki kitna sodium aapke liye sahi hai, aur kaun sa salt
khana chahiye?
Salt hona chahiye iodized, rock salt, sea salt?
Aur kahan use karna hai, ye aapki body weight, activity level, sweat level
ya sweat rate pe depend karta hai. Personalized hain ye saari cheezein.
Kyunki maine apni khud ki body pe ye saari cheezein apply karke dekh li.
Jab science samajh mein aaya, toh ye bhi samajh mein aaya ki kis tareeke se weight ghataya ja sakta hai, kya kya khana mujhe pachega, kaun sa gut ko achha lagega, kyun sugar kharab hai.
Toh ye saari cheezein mujhe batane wala koi nahi tha.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana,
decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer. Milte hain next video mein!
